pick.headline: Alexander Dubcek elected chairman of the Czechoslovak parliament
pick.summary: On 28 December 1989 Alexander Dubcek, leader of the 1968 Prague Spring, was elected chairman of the Federal Assembly of Czechoslovakia.
pick.significance: The return of the man deposed by the Soviet invasion completed the symbolism of the Velvet Revolution.
